contexts.text: Power and glory () = the internal sense of the Word. AC 2135, Preface. AC 4391:3. AC 5922:6.
When I was reading the Word... they called it glory.
(The notion that) heavenly joy consists in the light of glory...

I will make thy name great = glory... In the external sense, by... glory is signified something worldly; but in the internal sense, something heavenly. This Celestial consists... in being the least...
In heavenly glory there is not the least of worldly glory.
(Novitiates) who wanted to see the glory of the Lord... are put into a kind of sweet sleep... and thus they are let into the glory of Heaven... AC 2041:4.
Preface. [2]. In the Prophets... Glory = the Word in the life.
He supposes that there can be no glory without the glory of the world; when yet in the glory of Heaven there is not the least of the glory of the world. AC 2654.
For the sake of glory in Heaven.
The humiliation of man is not for the sake of the love of glory in the Lord...
Such things as good cannot agree with, namely, vain and empty things, as are those which are of the glory of the world and of self.
Glory is predicated of truth. AC 6355:end.
The Divine is in no affection of glory...
Glory is predicated of doctrine.
They receive truths... in order that they may glory...
As the end in understanding truths had been glorying...

When the Son of Man shall come in His glory () = when Divine truth shall appear in its own light, which happens to every man when he dies Glory = the intelligence and wisdom thence derived which appear as light... AC 5922:6.
Scientifics of no use have no end but glory and pleasure.

The glory of Heaven surpasses all the magnificence of the world... yet this is not the glory of Heaven; but the glory of Heaven is the Divine which shines forth from each thing there, and the perception of Divine things, and thence wisdom; but this glory exists solely with those there who make this magnificence of no account relatively to wisdom...
All my glory in Egypt () = the Spiritual Heaven in the Natural.

What glory is. Glory, in the supreme sense, = the Lord as to Divine truth, thus it = the Divine truth which proceeds from the Lord. Glory, in the representative sense, = the good of love towards the neighbour, or charity, which is the external good of the Celestial Kingdom, and the internal good of the Spiritual Kingdom; for this good, in the genuine sense, is the Divine truth in Heaven... Therefore, by the glory of Joseph, here, which they were to tell to Israel, is meant the Spiritual Heaven. The Spiritual Heaven is called glory because the things which are there appear in light, in splendour, in radiance.

Glory is predicated of the Divine truth which is from the Lord's Divine Human; and that it is attributed to the Lord as a King... is evident from... We saw His glory, the glory as of the Only-Begotten of the Father ()... Moses and Elias were seen in glory ().
It is called the glory of Jehovah relatively to the Inmost Heaven, and the glory of the God of Israel relatively to the Middle Heaven. Illustrated.

The reason Divine truth in the Heavens appears in glory, is that truth itself in the Spiritual Heaven appears before the eyes as a bright cloud... and the good in that truth appears as a fieriness, causing the cloud thus variegated by the fire to present wonderful appearances, which are glory in the external sense. But glory in the internal sense = intelligence and Wisdom; and these are what are represented by those appearances.
That Divine truth, from which are all intelligence and wisdom, and also the appearance of the variegated cloud before the external sight, is glory. Illustrated.
Glory, in the supreme sense, = the Divine Human, thus also Divine truth, because this comes from that. Not to give glory to another () = only to the Divine Human, which is one with Himself.
The reason the throne is called the throne of glory () is that judgments are made from truth.
Hence it is evident what is meant by glory in the Lord's Prayer.
Therefore glory is spoken of by Joseph, because Joseph... represents the Lord as to the Divine Spiritual, or Divine truth...
Thence come glory and Power. Signified. Namely, from the truth of faith and the good of charity.
For truth is glory to those who are in spiritual good.
The glory of the world, which is from the love of self, kindles this light...
Hence a wicked man... apparently rejoices and glories more than an upright man; but the glorying... of a wicked man is external... whereas the glorying of an upright man is internal...

As if He wanted to make a show of His glory... But it is not from self-glory, but from love... This is why the Lord so much extols His own power and glory in the Word. AC 8263, Explained. AC 10646:3, Explained.
I will sing to Jehovah = that the Lord alone has glory.

My song is Jah = that everything of faith and thence of glory is from the Divine truth which is from Him... For everything of glory which man has is from faith in the Lord; because faith which is faith is from the Lord; and so the Lord is in faith, and therefore glory itself. The reason the glory of man is from faith, is that the Divine truth, from which and through which comes faith, appears... as light and resplendence... This radiance of light, together with the magnificent things of Heaven which are from the light, is called glory, which is therefore nothing but Divine truth, thus faith.

In the morning ye shall see the glory of Jehovah () = that in the beginning of a new state there shall be the advent of the Lord... The glory of Jehovah = presence and advent. The reason glory = the presence and advent of the Lord, is that glory, in the supreme sense, = the Divine truth which proceeds from Him; and the Divine truth appears... as light and resplendence from the Sun... Therefore glory = the internal sense of the Word; for this is Divine truth in glory.
(Thus) by glory is signified the presence and advent of the Lord. Illustrated.
That the Lord as to Divine truth is glory. Illustrated.
Glory = the Divine of the Lord. Illustrated.
As by the glory of Jehovah is signified the Lord as to Divine truth, so also by glory is signified the Divine wisdom and intelligence, which is of Divine truth. Illustrated.
The glory of Jehovah was seen in the cloud () = the presence of the Lord in truth accommodated to apperception.

The glory which is in the cloud, is Divine truth not so accommodated to apperception, because it is above the fallacies and appearances of the senses; thus it = the internal sense... The reason glory = the internal sense... is that in that sense it treats of the Lord's Church and Kingdom; and, in the supreme sense, of the Lord Himself... Truth Divine is of many degrees... Truth Divine in the sixth degree... is the sense of the letter... This truth is represented by the cloud; and the interior truths, by the glory in the cloud.
For the glory of Jehovah = the presence of the Lord in the truth which proceeds from Him.
From this (the Angels in their state of evening) feel something of glory.
In its internal sense there is light like that of the Sun above the clouds, which light, in the Word, is called glory.
The Lord is called the King of glory () from the truth which is from good.
Natural light is like a cloud, and heavenly light is like the glory... when the cloud is removed; therefore... the internal sense is called glory. AC 9372:end. AC 9405:2.

They changed glory into the likeness of an ox... () = that they estranged themselves from the internal things of the Word and of the Church... For glory = what is internal of the Word and of the Church.
The glory of Lebanon (); that is, the cedar, = spiritual good and truth.

The glory of Jehovah stayed upon Mount Sinai () = the interiors of the Word of the Lord in Heaven. The glory of Jehovah, when predicated of the Word, = its internal sense, thus the interior things of the Word... The reason the interior things of the Word are called glory, is that the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord as a Sun is the light in Heaven... From this Divine light comes all glory in Heaven, which is such as to surpass all human apprehension. Hence it is evident why the internal sense... is glory; for the internal sense... is the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord in Heaven, thus it is the light from which comes all the glory there. This is meant by glory in many places in the Word. Illustrated.
To sit upon the throne of His glory = to judge from the Divine truth which is from Him.
By glory is signified the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord such as it is in Heaven. Illustrated. AC 9433:2.
The glory of men () = falsity.
The aspect of the glory of Jehovah () = the Divine truth in Heaven itself resplendent from the good of love... = the appearance of the Divine truth which proceeds from the Lord.
The glory of God () = the Divine truth which proceeds from the Lord.
Power and glory () = the internal sense, in which sense, inmostly, it treats of the Lord alone.
In their glory ye shall glory () = to enjoy truths, thus to enjoy joy and happiness from both.

For glory and for ornament () = in order to present, in its internal and in its external form, the Divine truth such as it is in the Spiritual Kingdom adjoined to the Celestial Kingdom; (for) glory = Divine truth... Hence it is that the Word in the internal sense is called glory.
Glory () = the intelligence which is of Divine truth.
For glory and for ornament () = the truth of the Spiritual Church.
The glory of Jehovah = the Lord as to Divine truth; for the Divine truth which proceeds from Him is the glory of Jehovah.
The Lord is called the King of glory from the Divine truth from which He fought, conquered, and subjugated the Hells.

That the glory of Jehovah = the Lord as to the Divine truth which proceeds from His Divine good... the Lord teaches in... The Word was made flesh, and we saw His glory, as the glory of the Only-Begotten of the Father ().
To enter into His glory () = to be united to the Divine good which was in Him... Illustrated.
He shall be sanctified in My glory () = what is receptive of Divine truth from the Lord... Glory = the Divine truth.
Cause me... to see Thy glory () = the apperception of internal Divine truth in external... The glory of Jehovah = the internal of the Word.

That by the glory of Jehovah is meant such a Divine as could not be apperceived by Moses... is I evident from the fact, that it is sometimes said that they saw the glory of Jehovah, but it was the cloud which was so called. Illustrated.

The reason the glory of Jehovah = the internal of the Word, of the Church, and of worship, is that the Divine truth which proceeds from the Lord, such as it is in Heaven, is the glory of Jehovah; for the Divine truth which proceeds from Him appears there as light; and the appearance of the Lord in this light is what is meant in the genuine sense by the glory of Jehovah...
The reason the internal of the Word, of the Church, and of worship, is signified by the glory of Jehovah, is that that internal is in that light...
From this it is evident what is signified by the glory of Jehovah... in the following places. Illustrated.
The glory in the midst thereof () = the Lord Himself as to all things of truth and good which are of faith and love.
That by glory (in these passages) are meant those things which are of Divine light, is evident.
As by glory are meant the things which are of light, it is said, The glory of God shall enlighten it ().

The glory of My people Israel () = all that which was revealed by the Lord concerning Himself, and concerning faith and love to Him with those who receive. All this is called glory, because it appears in Heaven, and in the light there...
Glory () = everything which appears concerning the Lord in that light.

These passages are quoted... because in them glory and light are mentioned together... and that it may be known that light = Divine truth from the Lord, thus the Lord Himself as to Divine truth; and that glory = everything which is of the light, thus everything which is from Divine truth which makes intelligence and wisdom with angels and men...

Glory () = Divine truth such as it is in the light of Heaven, thus such as it is with the Angels. And as Divine truth is meant by a cloud and glory, the Word as to the external and internal sense is meant.
Hence it is that a cloud is also called glory. Illustrated. AC 10574:14, Explained.
The advent of the Lord in the clouds of heaven with power and glory = His presence in the Word, and revelation... The glory of the Word = its internal sense.
[Swedenborg's footnote]: That glory, in the Word, = Divine truth such as it is in Heaven, and such as it is in the internal sense. References.
They placed the happiness of Heaven in glory and dominion.
The (celestial) Angels far excel in wisdom and glory...
Heavenly intelligence is... not for the sake of any glory...

They who are in the love of truth either for the sake of glory in the world, or for the sake of glory in Heaven, cannot shine... for the glory of self predominates... and when this glory is the end, the man regards himself... and the truths which serve for his glory, as means... For he who loves Divine truths for his own glory, regards himself in them...
Their infernal fire is the cupidity of glory...
He seeks dignities... that he may be in eminence and glory.
Glory = Divine truth such as it is in Heaven, and the derivative wisdom and intelligence. References.
Glory = the spiritual sense. DSS 14:2. AE 294:10. AE 906:2.
As the Lord alone conquered the Hells... He is called the King of glory, etc.
To give glory () = to glorify, or unite to Himself.

In His temple doth everyone speak of His glory () = that in each thing of the Word are Divine truths, DLW 413:3. For the sake of honour, glory, or gain in the world. DLW 414. DLW 416. DLW 418. DLW 419:end.
When he sees the evil in glory...
A person who is in dignity there, is indeed in magnificence and glory...
All gloryings over impieties are permissions...
In wars... from the love of glory he is in the delight of killing... To do this for the sake of one's own glory is diabolical...
As the Divine is of glory inexhaustible...

To Him be glory and strength... () = to Whom alone is Divine majesty and omnipotence... By glory, in the Word, where the Lord is treated of, is meant the Divine majesty, and it is predicated of His Divine wisdom.
By the glory in which they will see Him () is meant the Word in the spiritual sense.

The animals gave glory, and honour, and thanksgiving to Him... () = that the Word ascribes all truth, good, and worship to the Lord... For His glory is from Divine truth; and His honour, from Divine good. Illustrated. AR 253. AR 288. AR 291. AR 804.
They gave glory to the God of Heaven () = that they acknowledged the Lord, and were separated... To give glory = to acknowledge and worship. AE 678.
Give glory to Him... () = acknowledgement and confession that all the truth of the Word is from the Lord... ( = to live according to Divine truth. AE 874.)

By glory the Angels perceive nothing but Divine truth; and as all Divine truth is from the Lord, by to give glory to Him they perceive to acknowledge and confess that all truth is from Him; for all the glory in the Heavens is from no other source; and in proportion as a Society... is in Divine truth... the Angels are in the resplendence of glory.
That by glory is meant Divine truth. Illustrated.

The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from His power () = the inmost of Heaven full of Divine spiritual and celestial truth from the Lord... By glory is signified Divine spiritual truth. (Compare AE 955.)
Not to give Him glory () = not to receive in faith that the Lord is the God of Heaven and earth.
Under Glorify, see this reference.
Having the glory of God () = that in that Church the Word will be understood... By the glory of God is signified the Word in its Divine light. Illustrated.
For the glory of God did enlighten it () = that the men of that Church... will be in spiritual light from the Divine truth of the Word... The glory of God = the Divine truth of the Word.
To bring glory and honour into it () = to confess the Lord, and ascribe to Him all the truth and good which they have; (for) glory is predicated of Divine truth. AR 923.
That the men in the New Jerusalem will not be in Knowledges from... glory originating in pride. Signified.
There is a natural lumen from glory which originates in pride, and also not from pride. Explained.
(The honour and glory of the governors in Heaven.)
They who are in the love of glory, not from use, do not receive this influx.
Yon glory over us... but we do not glory over you...
(The devil said) We glory to eternity... we are allowed to glory... CL 264:3.
Devils have rationality from the glory of the love of self; for the love of self is encompassed with glory; and glory elevates the understanding even into the light of Heaven.
Under Cock, see this reference.
The glory of reputation...
They glory over the number of virginities...
Glory, in the Word, when predicated of the Lord, = Divine truth united to Divine good.
Each (earthly governor) has glory according to the extent of his office.
The glory and power in which He is to come = the spiritual sense of the Word.
That the glory in which He is to come = Divine truth in its light, in which is the spiritual sense of the Word. Illustrated.
He found glory and pleasure from thousands lying in their blood.
Like those who for glory desire to fall in battle...
They do not want to be called proud, but that it is glorying from their capacity of memory.
(He supposed) that heavenly joy consists in the lumen of glory; in such a lumen as when the solar rays appear golden... SE 5993:2.
There is still a resistance from his desire of glory in life.
He did it for the sake of his own glorying. SE 3619.
He believed that this was for the glory of his country.
Genuine glory is the glory of uses abstracted from self... This glory is delight of heart...
Paul supposed there would be worldly glory there...
To Him be glory and strength... = that Divine truth and Divine good are from the Lord alone...

The reason glory = Divine truth in Heaven, is that Divine truth there is light, and the things which come forth from the light of Heaven are called glory; because they come forth from the Lord... and tell of His glory...
Glory be to God does not mean that God wants glory... except for man's sake...
The salvation of mankind is the Lord's glory. References.
That glory = Divine truth in Heaven, thus the internal sense, because this is Divine truth in Heaven. References.
Thine is the kingdom, the power, and the glory = Divine truth from God alone...
Glory = Divine truth such as it is in Heaven.
Glory = Divine truth, thus the Word. References.
I will till this house with glory () = the Church, with Divine truth.
Glory = Divine truth in Heaven.
Glory = intelligence from Divine truth.
Glory = Divine truth; and honour, Divine good. AE 339. AE 345. AE 1198.
When glory and honour are mentioned, glory = truth, and honour good. Fully illustrated.
Worthy art Thou to receive glory, and honour, and power () = the merit and justice which belong to the Lord's Divine Human, that from it are all Divine truth. Divine good, and salvation.
To receive into glory = to bless with intelligence.
When glory is predicated of the Lord, it = Divine truth and Divine wisdom; but when of man, it = the derivative intelligence.
The glorying of falsity. Signified. AE 324:14.
The glory of the gentiles () = genuine truth from the good of love, thus the conjunction of them.
The flower of glory () = truth at its birth destroyed.
The Divine truth which makes the Church is signified by glory.
Glorying from intelligence thence. Signified. AE 388:12.
Their reformation is signified by, Jehovah hath exhibited Himself glorious in Israel ().
To give glory to God = to acknowledge Divine truth.
To set glory = worship from internal things.
Glory = truth from that good.

Glory, in the Word, = Divine truth proceeding from Him; the glory of the God of Israel, Divine truth enlightening those who are in His Spiritual Kingdom; and the glory of Jehovah, Divine truth enlightening those who are in His Celestial Kingdom.

The reason Divine truth is called glory, is that Divine truth is the light of Heaven, and from that light come all resplendence, magnificence, and glory there; for whatever appears before the eyes in the Heavens is from that light. Hence, also, it is said that the earth is enlightened by His glory...
Divine truth from that good is meant by, His glory shall be seen upon thee.
The glory of the God of Israel = the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord.
To come and see the glory of the Lord () = to be enlightened with Divine truth, and thence to enjoy heavenly joy; for the glory of the Lord = Divine truth, and enlightenment and joy from it.
The eyes of the glory of Jehovah () = Divine truth.
Blessing, glory, and wisdom () = these from the Divine truth which proceeds from the Lord in the three Heavens... Glory = the reception of Divine truth in interior things. References.
The reception of Divine truth in the Second Heaven is called glory.
The glory in the midst of her () = Divine truth in light on every side.
The glory of Moab () = falsities from evil.
Glory = spiritual good and truth.
The glory of Jehovah = the Divine truth which makes Heaven and the Church.
All the truths of Heaven and the Church... are signified by glory.
Glory = Divine truth in light. AE 727:4.
The city of glory () = the doctrine of Divine truth.

Glory, in the Word, when predicated of the Lord, properly = the Divine truth proceeding from Him, because that Divine truth is the light of Heaven, and from that light Angels and men derive not only all their intelligence and wisdom, but also all their happiness; and, moreover, all magnificence in the Heavens... is thence derived. These things, therefore, are what are properly signified by the glory of God. Hence it follows, that the glory of the Lord = to enlighten Angels and men, and to gift with intelligence and wisdom, and to bless with all things happy and delightful, and also to give magnificence to all things in the Heavens; and that this glory is not from the love of glory, but from love towards the human race. Illustrated.
Glory = Divine truth proceeding from the Lord; and the glory of the Lord with man = the reception of Divine truth.
From natural affection, which is for the sake of glory, etc.
The glory of the forest and Carmel () = the truth and good of truth belonging to the Church.
The king's daughter is all glorious within () = the spiritual affection of truth, which is called glorious from the abundance of truth.

To give glory to Him () = to live according to Divine truth, that is, according to His precepts in the Word. Glory, when predicated of the Lord, = Divine truth proceeding from Him, thus the Word such as it is in Heaven; for this is light to the Angels, whereby the Lord manifests His glory; for by that light He gives intelligence and wisdom, and also presents... magnificent things, which shine... This, in the proximate sense, is signified by the glory of the Lord. But as all these magnificent things... are given... according to the reception of Divine truth... they appear to the Angels according to their wisdom... and as their wisdom is according to the reception of Divine truth, in both doctrine and life, therefore by giving glory to Him, is signified to live according to Divine truth.
Glory = Divine truth spiritual, such as exists in the Heavens.
The glory of God = the light of Heaven, which is Divine truth in the spiritual sense.
Glory = the Divine truth in the Word.
Not to give Him glory = not to live according to the Lord's precepts.
The earth was enlightened from his glory () = the Church now in light from the influx and reception of Divine truth.
To give glory () = to acknowledge, confess, and worship the Lord.
On delight from the glory of being wise.
The spiritual affection of use is for the sake of the glory of God...
With military officers, there is the glory of use, and the glory of honour; with those who are charities, there is the glory of use, and not the glory of honour.
God 5. 6. The light thence proceeding is the resplendence of love, which is meant by glory in the Word.
In this new Church there will be spiritual peace, which is glory...
